name: Python (uv) + Claude Code, hardened
description: Python dev container built on ghcr.io/grst/devcontainers/python: uv with Python 3.14, ruff, prek, Claude Code in auto mode, rootless podman for nested containers, a mandatory egress-firewall choice, and an isolation check that keeps the workspace the only writable host path.

firewall.description: Restrict outbound network traffic to an allowlist? There is deliberately no default: 'on' gives a default-DROP egress firewall (Anthropic API, PyPI, npm, GitHub, Ubuntu archive) and adds the NET_ADMIN/NET_RAW capabilities it needs; 'off' leaves egress unrestricted, which means an agent that reads a malicious file can reach any host on the internet. The container refuses to start until this is set.

claudeAuth.description: How Claude Code authenticates in this repo. 'login' passes no API key into the container at all: run 'claude' once in here and log in, and that login lives in the container's own config volume and survives rebuilds. 'api-key' resolves an Anthropic API key on the host and injects it, which bills the API instead of your subscription. The container refuses to start on any other value.

pythonVersion.description: Default Python for a bare 'uv venv' / 'uv sync'. A project's own requires-python or .python-version still wins. 3.14 and 3.13 are baked into the image; anything else is downloaded on first use.

peonPing.description: Wire Claude Code's hooks to the peon-ping notification relay on the host? Sounds and desktop notifications are played by the host relay; the hook directory is mounted read-only.

imageTag.description: Tag of ghcr.io/grst/devcontainers/python to use. A template published from a release tag defaults this to the matching image version, so applying that template pins you to the image built in the same run; the copy published from main defaults to 'latest'.
